phase1_assignment.objective: Test multi-run planning, checkpoint reconstruction, forecast-overrun detection, alternative-plan switching and stale or duplicate continuation defenses for scheduled Chat agents.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; direct probe before decomposition; compare a valid continuation trace with stale, duplicated and forecast-overrun traces and persist switching criteria.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A tested mechanism or exact blocker, tested scope, durable checkpoint and exact next Phase-1 action.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

policy.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope.
policy.continuation: One result or blocker is not global completion; preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action.

control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When that lookup is unavailable, read the approved root and role-config paths twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.failure: Write a diagnostic checkpoint, retain the recurring schedule, and retry on the next invocation.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.

migration.reason: Add the current Phase-1 assignment and a Chat-available authority bootstrap fallback after the pool recheck.
migration.rollback_condition: Only a proven authority or CLEAN-isolation failure.
